integrity: Self-contained theorem and proof; standard-library verifier independently checks Fano incidence, simplicial ranks, all 336 symmetry traces and the published matching-character comparison.
scientific_limitations: Integral equivariant homology module, not equivariant homotopy. The Fano group computation is exhaustive for order two; general finite planes are covered by the exact Mayer–Vietoris proof. The representation isomorphism with a different Heawood matching-complex constituent is only rational; no canonical cross-complex map is asserted. Residual originality uncertainty remains for unindexed specialist literature.
title: Twisted incidence-cycle homology in projective-plane Vietoris–Rips filtrations
